title: Sable and the Portrait
author: Bram Vasquez
blurb: Edmund Oyelaran, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
